content.text: No exclusivity obligation binds us anywhere in the agreement — and the licence grant affirmatively preserves our sourcing freedom.

input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder, so long as such
input.rationale: The agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Mortgage Logic.com, meeting the preferred position. Section 2(a) (p0022/p0024) goes further than mere silence: the licence is expressly "non-exclusive" and Client is affirmatively "not obligated to utilize the License" and is "free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system... to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink," subject only to non-infringement of TrueLink's IP and our Section 10 confidentiality obligations — both ordinary carve-outs, not sourcing restrictions. Review of the Client covenants (Section 8), compensation/pricing (Sections 5-6), and the balance of the document found no "sole and exclusive provider," requirements-purchase, or "shall not procure from any third party" language binding us. The only "exclusive" references run in our favour or are immaterial here: the non-exclusive licence to us (p0022), our grant of a nonexclusive licence in Credit Data to TrueLink (p0054), and an exclusive-forum provision (p0094). Two minor points noted rather than flagged: (i) Section 3(i) (p0042) requires Client to order a TrueLink credit report on each borrower for which underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface — a narrow captive-ordering commitment confined to transactions we voluntarily route through the Interface, which we can avoid entirely given we are not obligated to use the licence at all, so it does not amount to an exclusivity or requirements obligation on our purchasing freedom; and (ii) the Credit Data licence to TrueLink is subject to a separate Non-Competition Agreement (p0054) that is not part of this document and should be diligenced separately for any restrictive covenant binding us. No redline required.
